verdict.rationale: Kick documents automation rules that run automatically, an Activity audit trail that logs changes, and MCP changes made 'with your approval'. None of these provide versioning of rules, review of rule revisions, or rollback to a prior automation state. The audit trail and approval prompts are adjacent controls, not versioning or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
